description: A gray power strip lies on the bed in front of a pillow, with a white power adapter plugged into it and a white cable looped nearby. The left hand steadies the power strip in place while the right hand grips the white adapter, pulls it upward and outward to unplug it, then moves it down and sets it on the bed, leaving the strip as a left-hand object and the adapter as a right-hand object until it’s released.
